question: Who was elected as the first woman speaker of Uttarakhand Legislative Assembly in March 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ritu Khanduri.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ritu Khanduri **was elected as the **first woman speaker **of **Uttarakhand Legislative Assembly** in **March 2022.**
 
• Ritu Khanduri is a member of the **Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP)** and represents the** Yamkeshwar constituency **in the assembly.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Madhabi Puri Buch** is **not related** to Uttarakhand Legislative Assembly.

 
 
• She is a former whole-time member of the **Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI).**
 
 
 
• **Abhilasha Barak **is also **not related** to Uttarakhand Legislative Assembly.
 
 
• She is a social activist from Haryana and is known for her work in the field of women's empowerment.
 
 
 
• **Santishree Pandit** is also **not related **to Uttarakhand Legislative Assembly.
 
 
• She is a** Marathi actress** and has worked in several **Marathi films and TV shows.**
 
 
 
• Hence, the** correct** option is 1) Ritu Khanduri.
